labels.name: bug
labels.description: Confirmed defect in numerical behavior, correctness, error handling, or documented contract.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New capability or meaningful improvement to existing behavior.

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: README, Wiki, examples, source comments, or other user-facing documentation.

labels.name: refactor
labels.description: Internal restructuring or maintainability work with no intended behavior change.

labels.name: testing
labels.description: Regression tests, numerical edge coverage, fault injection, and test infrastructure.

labels.name: CI
labels.description: Continuous integration, automated checks, Excel regression gates, and evidence automation.

labels.name: release
labels.description: Release process, packaging, provenance, tagging, changelog, and artifact governance.

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Runtime performance, algorithmic efficiency, scalability, or performance benchmarking.

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Critical: release-blocking correctness or silent-wrong-result defect; fix immediately.

labels.name: P2
labels.description: High: material numerical defect or engineering risk; fix in the next planned milestone.

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Normal: non-blocking improvement, hardening, refactor, documentation, or cleanup.

labels.name: core
labels.description: Core floating-point primitives, constants, guards, arithmetic helpers, and shared numerics.

labels.name: special-functions
labels.description: Gamma, beta, log-gamma/log-beta, incomplete functions, combinatorial and inverse kernels.

labels.name: normal-family
labels.description: Standard Normal, Normal, Lognormal, Gaussian tails, intervals, and inverse-normal behavior.

labels.name: t-family
labels.description: Student t, Chi-square, F distributions, and their shared numerical paths.

labels.name: continuous
labels.description: Gamma, Beta, Exponential, Weibull, Uniform, and other continuous-distribution surfaces.

labels.name: discrete
labels.description: Binomial, Poisson, Geometric, Negative Binomial, Hypergeometric, and Discrete Uniform.

labels.name: accuracy
labels.description: Accuracy contracts, numerical envelopes, references, holdouts, benchmarks, and limitations.

labels.name: api
labels.description: Worksheet/VBA API, parameterization, compatibility, return values, and caller contracts.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Well-scoped task suitable for a first contribution to the repository.

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Maintainer welcomes external investigation, implementation, validation, or review.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot progress until a dependency, decision, prerequisite fix, or evidence step is resolved.
